subject: pharmacology
title: Contraception: Combined Pill, Minipill, Emergency Contraception, Centchroman, DMPA, Mifepristone and Misoprostol

steps.tx: The **combined oral contraceptive pill** pairs ethinylestradiol with a progestin to suppress the mid cycle LH surge (progestin) and FSH driven follicular recruitment (oestrogen), thicken cervical mucus and thin the endometrium as backups, with perfect use failure under 1 percent and typical use near 7 percent yearly. Generations of progestins trade androgenicity against venous thrombosis increments, and non contraceptive dividends (acne, cycle control, ovarian and endometrial cancer protection) share the counselling page with the risks.
steps.say: Two hormones, three mechanisms, one adherence sermon; typical use, not perfect use, is the honest number.

vis.alt: Combined oral contraceptive pill pack and mechanism illustration
vis.caption: Combined pill pack and its ovulation suppression mechanism, the reference hormonal contraceptive. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Combined pill contraindications are** thrombosis and oestrogen arithmetic (UKMEC in British practice): migraine with aura, age 35 plus smoking, uncontrolled hypertension, thrombophilia or previous venous thromboembolism, early postpartum and breastfeeding windows, and enzyme inducing drugs gutting efficacy. Arterial events ride smoking and age; venous events ride dose, progestin generation and obesity. The eligibility grid, not habit, writes the first prescription and every renewal after intercurrent diagnoses.
steps.say: Aura, cigarettes past thirty five, and clots close the combined pill door; grade eligibility, do not guess it.

left.title: Combined pill exclusions
points: Migraine with aura at any age

steps.tx: The **minipill** (progestogen only pill) trades the oestrogen ledger away: traditional norethindrone types thicken mucus with a strict three hour daily window, while desogestrel pills also suppress ovulation and forgive twelve hours. They suit breastfeeding, migraine with aura, thrombosis histories and oestrogen intolerance, charging irregular bleeding as their universal toll and ectopic proportion vigilance (absolute risk falls, proportion among failures rises) as their footnote.
steps.say: Progestogen only means oestrogen problems forgiven and bleeding patterns taxed; desogestrel forgives lateness too.

vis.caption: Progestogen only pills, the oestrogen free daily option with strict timing for traditional types. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Emergency contraception** races ovulation: levonorgestrel 1.5 mg delays it when given before the LH surge (best within 72 hours, licensed so), **ulipristal** 30 mg postpones even a rising surge to 120 hours and outperforms levonorgestrel late and at higher body weight, and the copper intrauterine device prevents implantation near perfectly beyond 120 hours while continuing as contraception. None interrupts an implanted pregnancy, none protects the rest of the cycle, and quick starting ongoing contraception (with ulipristal's five day progestogen delay) completes the consultation.
steps.say: Emergency contraception delays ovulation, copper prevents implantation; none ends an implanted pregnancy.

vis.alt: Emergency contraception options illustration with timing windows
vis.caption: Emergency contraception timing windows for levonorgestrel, ulipristal and the copper device. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Centchroman** (ormeloxifene), India's non steroidal weekly pill from CSIR CDRI, is a SERM antagonising endometrium against implantation while sparing ovulation, taken twice weekly for three months then weekly, with delayed cycles as its main effect and a failure rate near 2 percent. It embodies the SERM grid from the previous lessons in contraceptive dress and is an examination favourite precisely because the rest of the world barely stocks it.
steps.say: Centchroman is the weekly non hormonal SERM pill; cycles delay, ovulation continues.

left.title: Centchroman profile
points: Weekly SERM, anti implantation endometrial action

right.title: Long acting neighbours
points: Implants: 3 years, most effective reversible class

steps.tx: **DMPA** (depot medroxyprogesterone acetate) injects contraception quarterly (intramuscular or subcutaneous), suppressing ovulation profoundly enough to cause the module's most debated profile: hypo oestrogenic bone density loss (largely reversible, caution in adolescents), weight gain, irregular then absent bleeding, and fertility return delayed a median of ten months after the last injection. It suits adherence independent needs where its metabolic and bone ledgers are acceptable and reviewed.
steps.say: DMPA is quarterly, private and bone taxed, with fertility returning on its own slow schedule.

vis.caption: Injectable progestogen contraception, DMPA, given every three months. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Mifepristone** with misoprostol is medical termination's evidence base: progesterone receptor blockade decidualises and detaches the pregnancy and sensitises the uterus, then the prostaglandin E1 analogue **misoprostol** expels it, with success 95 to 98 percent in early gestation under regulated protocols and gestational limits. Misoprostol alone serves cervical ripening, labour induction at low dose, postpartum haemorrhage where oxytocin is unavailable (heat stable, its global health superpower) and ulcer protection history from the NSAID era.
steps.say: Mifepristone unlocks progesterone's grip, misoprostol empties the uterus; heat stability makes the second a global drug.

left.title: Mifepristone in termination
points: Followed by misoprostol in 24 to 48 hours
Regulated by gestational limits and follow up

right.title: Misoprostol's many rooms
points: Cervical ripening and labour induction (low dose)
Postpartum haemorrhage where cold chains fail
Diarrhoea and shivering as dose tolls

steps.tx: **Missed pill rules and** method switching are the applied examinations of this lesson: combined pill lapses beyond 48 hours need backup and consideration of emergency contraception by timing, progestogen only windows are three or twelve hours by type, and long acting methods forgive the entire category of error, which is why efficacy league tables rank implants and intrauterine methods first. Counselling that matches method to the patient's actual life, not the ideal one, is the intervention with the largest effect size in the lesson.
steps.say: Match the method to the life actually lived; long acting methods forgive what daily pills cannot.
